cases.prompt: Summarize the release checklist for this project.
cases.expected_output: draft the release note before tagging
cases.baseline_output: tag the version after the code is merged
cases.ace_output: draft the release note before tagging and confirm example commands still run from the repo root

cases.prompt: What should happen before a new command is merged?
cases.expected_output: one happy-path test and one failure-path test
cases.baseline_output: add a command and wait for CI
cases.ace_output: add one happy-path test and one failure-path test for every new command

cases.prompt: What is the first step during issue triage?
cases.expected_output: reproduce the problem before changing code or docs
cases.baseline_output: reproduce the problem before changing code or docs
cases.ace_output: reproduce the problem before changing code or docs and log the failing command or file path
